The '''Holographic bounty list''' was a [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] used to advertise [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]]. [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] used her [[Hush-98 comlink/Legends|Hush-98 comlink]] on this device to take [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress's]] bounty. The device also advertised criminals [[Nim Mindbend/Legends|Nim Mindbend]], [[Omar Toggs/Legends|Omar Toggs]], and [[Zug Tassik/Legends|Zug Tassik]].
